title: Admin Cockpit
tagline: See whether abap2UI5 is used, fast and safely configured, in one abap2UI5 app with a security traffic light.
summary: An abap2UI5 app for administrators and IT leads that shows usage and errors per app, response times with their phases, the draft table and a security traffic light of the installation. The Installation & Security and Drafts & Housekeeping tabs need no logging at all; the usage, error and performance tabs fill once a one-line hook in your HTTP handler or the monitor hook of abap2UI5 records the roundtrips. It steps through what a user did session by session, replays failed events with the headless frontend, records requests and responses, raises alerts and purges its own tables. Privacy mode is on by default: no user names are stored.
features: Overview tiles: active users, roundtrips, p95 response time, error rate, alerts
Errors grouped by app, event and exception, with the user's steps and a replay
Slowest roundtrips with phase breakdown and runtime hints
Sessions step by step, find a value in all drafts, delete expired drafts
Security traffic light: CSRF origin check, CSP, security headers, developer addons
Recorder replays what the user saw and did, with story and process variants
Privacy by default: users counted under a daily SHA-256 pseudonym
requirements: ABAP Cloud or Standard ABAP 7.50 or higher, released APIs only; the 7.02 downport is linted in CI
abap2UI5 1.146.0 or later; branch main needs an abap2UI5 with the monitor hook z2ui5_if_ui5_monitor, otherwise branch standalone
Optional: abap2UI5-addons/abap-agent-runtime for the Agents tab
Optional: abap2UI5-addons/lock-manager for its monitor on the Live tab

notes: Install abap2UI5 first, then this repository with abapGit into a package of its own (for example Z2UI5_COCKPIT, folder logic PREFIX)
Branch main for an abap2UI5 with z2ui5_if_ui5_monitor (the release after 1.146.0); branch standalone for abap2UI5 1.146.0 or later without the monitor hook
Start ?app_start=z2ui5_cl_cockpit_app and claim the administrator role: the first user who presses the button becomes the administrator
Hook the cockpit into your own HTTP handler: replace z2ui5_cl_ui5_http_handler=>run( server ) with z2ui5_cl_cockpit_wire=>run( server ) once every object is active
Or switch the monitor hook on in your user exit: cs_config-check_monitor_active = abap_true in set_config_http_post
Schedule z2ui5_cl_cockpit_job=>run( ) every 15 minutes for housekeeping and alerts

usage:
METHOD if_http_extension~handle_request.
  z2ui5_cl_cockpit_wire=>run( server ).  " instead of z2ui5_cl_ui5_http_handler=>run( server )
ENDMETHOD.
